releases.displayName: New update for Frontier Pilot Simulator: Optimization and full readiness!

items.text: We are pleased to announce the release of a new update for Frontier Pilot Simulator!
This release is the result of our hard work on optimizing the game, resulting in a significant improvement in its performance.
The game now runs much smoother with no sudden FPS sags, providing you with an uninterrupted and immersive gaming experience.
It is especially important to note that in this update we have achieved 100% game readiness, meeting all our original plans.
This means you're getting exactly what we envisioned from the beginning, and we're sure you'll love it!
In addition, we're excited to announce the release of Frontier Pilot Simulator on consoles!
Now even more players will be able to immerse themselves in the exciting world of our pilot simulator.
Finally, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to all players for their support and faith in us.
This update was made possible thanks to your support and we appreciate each and every one of you.

I have some important news to share with you all about the game we have been working on. As many of you may already know, the development team consisted of employees from the Czech Republic, Ukraine, and Russia. Unfortunately, just before the end of last year, we experienced a break in development. This was further compounded by the outbreak of war, which ultimately led to the original team splitting up.

However, we are happy to announce that there is now another team working on the project, focused on porting the game to the PS5 and Xbox by the end of this year. We understand that many of you have been eagerly waiting for updates and we apologize for the long silence.

The future of the game will be decided after its release on these platforms. We appreciate the continued support and interest from our fans, and we thank you for your patience as we work towards a successful release.
Thank you, and stay tuned for further updates.

releases.displayName: Update Vol.27 - Sky, Night, Bases, Sound, Optimization, Animals

items.text: Welcome to your Wednesday news, I'm Lara White.

Our major news today comes to us from Astlan, where the Raglor research department has detected more new creatures! One, which looks similar to a whale from back on Earth, has been spotted off the coast of Astlan Island. Another creature, which has been named “Drako,” has also been spotted flying around in the upper atmospheric layers, so pilots are warned to be careful at higher altitudes.
And more great news comes from Raglor, where Nord Corporation has launched their first ocean tanker after just a few years of construction.
Nord Corporation has also produced a new onboard system for Frontier Pilots, which will be installed on each pilot’s ship, free of charge!

Finally, in our last headline today, the Raglor meteorological station has detected changes in the planet's atmosphere, which are causing anomalous phenomena. According to the MCC, these occurrences will be observable during both day and night, for the foreseeable future.
And as always, additional news related to general life on the planet is displayed on your screens.
That's all the news for today, I’ve been Lara White. I hope you all have a good one, and I’ll see you next week!

items.text: A new update arrived. Thank you all for the support, ideas, reviews, and test. After 2 weeks of testing, we finally start to receive positive feedback from the players.
This update mainly focuses on new flight physics.
What else we added to this update?
Particles appearance (wind and rain) in the hangar - Fixed

After 2 years of research, we found out that the whole planet inhabited by animals, but the human eye can not catch their movements, but our research department created a device that can uncover hidden fauna on this planet.
We tried to convince the head of Raglor to invest money into the research and start a massive production but after long negotiations, he declined our offer.

One philanthropist on earth offers us such a deal. He delivers here from the earth 3 types of cargoes and sells it here ( which we need for massive production of the device), but it has to be delivered to the research platform. That why we would like to aks some help from the Frontier Pilots community. Deliver as much a possible: Lenses, Cases, Chips. to research the platform. After receiving 500.000 containers of each product all of the frontier pilots will be supplied with this device for free.
As we promised, a second testing version of the new flight physics available for test.
We took into account most of your suggestions and complaints.

A new update released. Thank you all for the support, ideas, and help with development. Also, our group call helps us to understand some of your concerns. You are the best community we can imagine.

The main changes are in the flight model. We Redesigned flight physics in airplane mode. Switching to the plane mode, automatically turning on the engine economy mode; increased the aerodynamic effect of the flaps, and other "plumage" of the ship. A complete explanation can be found here: https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/673210/view/2378411445038286184
Also, we added features that you asked for a long time such as: Contacts button (N) - show the list of the current quests, Weather menu.
Another big part of the game that we change is refactoring of all wind, volcanos, weather effects, clouds and etc.. That should increase the FPS.
We reorganized the quest systems in order to make it compatible with the contact feature.
The visual part also changed. We changed the scarab model and an internal view of the rescue capsule. Plus some of the bases have been changed.
We reduced the energy consumption of AR mode and added new upgrades which reduce 10 times the energy consumption.
New upgrades for all ships - added
Animated people on the bases - added

The community of Frontier pilots filed a petition to allow pilots to customize their ships. After long discussions, the Head of Transport Committee signed a paper to allow Frontier Pilots to Customize their ships.

Also, he gave an order to the Raglor engineering department starts to work on the customization boxes and integrate it to each base on the planet. In this regard, 1.000.000 credits have been allocated by Raglor private investors.

Unfortunately, it's now enough. That why the Raglor engineering department asks the Frontier Community to deliver goods on the total amount of 500.000.000 credits. Once this amount will be reached the engineering department installs to each hangar customization boxes.
We will update the total amount each week.

notes.title: The first version of augmented reality, the “super-vision” mode that can be used in flight: detailing the terrain, regardless of weather, day time, or other visual complications.

items.text: The operating mode of the radar allows piloting even in conditions of insufficient visibility.
It is activated by the V button on the keyboard, Left Bumper + X on the gamepad or the ship's menu in the radar tab.
It consumes energy and turns off when the radar is damaged.

notes.title: It makes it easier to find supply and demand for goods or passengers of interest. Still, in development - it will be improved and supplemented.

items.text: Economic map of the world. In the first version of the new map, the entire system for displaying cities was redesigned: detailed descriptions, routes for buying or selling goods, displaying passengers, upgrades and the presence of ships at the bases added. Also, the features of the bases, such as the presence of a runway, hangar, etc. Plus, filters allow you to focus only on the selected type of action.

Graphical improvements: Time changing added. The polar day can be observed. Still in development: lightning of bases and runways, ship devices.: Planned in the next update: Adding new weather conditions. A few new winds, a tornado and etc.: Updated weather effects: smoke mists, geysers, volcanoes. Several bugs related to them have been fixed.

Improved landscape appearance: Planned in the next update: “The Raglor landscapes Decoration. A full-scale improvement of objects and the surface of the continent is planned, the addition of interesting places and just a greater variety of visual range, especially in desert areas.”

Flight physics: Updated flight physics in airplane mode, and chassis control.: The physics of the aircraft has been improved towards realistic calculations of the atmosphere influence on the ship.: Chassis physics has been improved, pressure sensors and a chassis overload indicator have been added.: Several improvements and fixes, in particular, improvements in the appearance of several bases and passengers.
